verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes DeepInfra-hosted options: the managed API, dedicated private-endpoint instances, and rented B200/B300 clusters with SSH. All of these run on DeepInfra's own cloud, so they are adjacent features, not the ability to self-host the core product. Nothing documents an on-prem or self-hosted distribution.
